Before I download all the available data, I'm going to test it on the control samples from GSE247228.

The sra Run numbers are as follows:
    - SRR26705626
    - SRR26705627
    - SRR26705629

## Get FASTQ Files

I'll be using SRA-Toolkit/2.10.8 for this. Specifically, the `fasterq-dump` function.

```{bash get-computing-power}
srun_l -c 12 -p himem --x11 --pty bash
```

```{bash get-fastqs}
ml SRA-Toolkit/2.10.8
fasterq-dump --outdir input/fastqs --progress SRR26705626 SRR26705627 SRR26705629
```

## Update Reference Genome

I need to add the GFP sequence to our reference genome before aligning our fastqs. I'll be adding it to our 10x-mm10 reference genome. Our new reference will be in custom_ref/10x-mm10-gfp

I will first need to create a file named GFP.fa containing the nucleotide sequence for our GFP protein.

```{bash make-new-ref}
#get number of bases in GFP.fa
grep -v "^>" custom_ref/GFP.fa | tr -d "\n" | wc
#922 bases

#lets make a custom gtf for gfp; \t helps us make new columns that are needed in the gtf
echo -e 'GFP\tunknown\texon\t1\t922\t.\t+\t.\tgene_id "GFP"; transcript_id "GFP"; gene_biotype "proetin_coding";' > custom_ref/GFP.gtf

#copy mm10 reference FASTA over (so we can modify it and not screw up the og)
cp /home/gdrobertslab/lab/GenRef/10x-mm10/fasta/genome.fa custom_ref/genome.fa

#append GFP.fa to end of mm10 genome
cat custom_ref/GFP.fa >> custom_ref/genome.fa

#check that GFP "chromosome" is present
grep ">" custom_ref/genome.fa

#copy over original gtf and gunzip
cp /home/gdrobertslab/lab/GenRef/10x-mm10/genes/genes.gtf.gz custom_ref/.
chmod 744 custom_ref/*
gunzip custom_ref/genes.gtf.gz

#append GFP gtf to mm10 gene file
cat custom_ref/GFP.gtf >> custom_ref/genes.gtf

#Time to make our new reference using cellranger mkref
cellranger mkref --output-dir custom_ref/demo_GFP \
    --genome demo_GFP \
    --fasta custom_ref/genome.fa \
    --genes custom_ref/genes.gtf

# We need to convert our fastq names to a cellranger compatible format
# I'll just be doing this for SRR26
mv input/fastqs/SRR26705626/SRR26705626_1.fastq \
    input/fastqs/SRR26705626/SRR26705626_S1_R1_001.fastq
mv input/fastqs/SRR26705626/SRR26705626_2.fastq \
    input/fastqs/SRR26705626/SRR26705626_S1_R2_001.fastq

for sra in SRR26705626 SRR26705627 SRR26705629
do
    mv input/fastqs/${sra}/${sra}_1.fastq \
        input/fastqs/${sra}/${sra}_S1_R1_001.fastq
    mv input/fastqs/${sra}/${sra}_2.fastq \
        input/fastqs/${sra}/${sra}_S1_R2_001.fastq
done

#run cellranger count!
sbatch cellranger_count.sh
```
